besluite.fout: 'Trek jou hand van jou nek af' first reads as 'pull your hand away from your neck', not as running it down the back.
besluite.rede: 'Gly met jou hand' is the natural expression for the action and the meaning (neck down to the lower back) is unchanged.
The sentence already flows, and 'net een enkele' is a deliberate emphasis that the next sentence pays off, so dropping it and reordering is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: Bare singular 'Vis' as a group name is unusual and breaks the parallel with the four plural group names.
besluite.rede: 'Visse' is the normal Afrikaans name for the group and the rest of the sentence still agrees.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins 'Ons noem hulle ...' and 'die ander naam daarvoor is ...', each with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and leaves the term 'ongewerwelde diere' intact.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with subjects 'Insekte' and 'hulle'.
besluite.rede: The comma is required and the protected wording 'hulle vlieg of loop op pote' after it is untouched.

besluite.fout: 'geen ruggraat nie en 'n harde buitekant' can be read as negating the hard outside too, especially beside the worm item 'geen ruggraat nie en ook geen harde dop nie'.
besluite.rede: 'maar wel' makes it unambiguous that the scorpion has a hard outside, which is what the original says, and matches the crab item's 'maar'.

besluite.fout: A word discussed as a word is unmarked, so 'Die woord bene beteken' makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: Quotation marks mark the mentioned word and change nothing in the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'steeds' used in the concessive sense of English 'still' is an anglicism; in Afrikaans it suggests 'continually'.
besluite.rede: 'tog' is the Afrikaans concessive word here and the claim (they walk on legs yet have no bones) is unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'hou sy lyf veilig teen' is wooden.
besluite.rede: 'beskerm sy lyf teen' is the exact natural verb with the same meaning and the same two threats.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins sentences with subjects 'Baie slakke' and 'ons'.
besluite.rede: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and changes no words.
'Die slak ... daardie skulp' ties back to the snails that carry a shell, whereas a general ''n Slak bou sy skulp' implies every snail has one and loses the 'baie' qualifier of the previous sentence.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins sentences with subjects ''n Wurm' and 'sy lyf'.
besluite.rede: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and changes no words.

besluite.fout: 'reguit ... vas' in the ruggraat definition can be read as 'straight' in shape rather than 'directly attached'.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition and a word-choice change there belongs to the writer.
